messages.content: Reply in exactly two sentences. Explain why a lid belongs on a pot of soup.
A lid keeps heat over the soup, so it simmers instead of cooling off. It also stops splashes from reaching the stove.
Answer in three bullet points, and no other text. List what to pack for a rainy walk.

- A coat with a hood
- Shoes that can get wet
- A small towel for the doorway
Use the word cedar exactly once. Describe a park bench.
The bench is made of cedar, with a high back and room for two people to sit facing the pond.
Write one sentence of exactly eight words about a red bicycle.
The red bicycle leans against the blue gate.
Respond in lowercase only. Say how to tell when rice is done.
the grains are tender all the way through and no hard center remains.
Return only a JSON object with keys title and minutes. The task is boiling an egg.
{"title": "Boil an egg", "minutes": 9}
Do not use the letter q. Give a short tip for watering a fern.
Water the soil when it feels dry on top, and let the extra drain away.
Start your reply with Yes. Then name one reason to label a freezer box.
Yes. A label tells you what is inside without opening the box and warming the food.
End your reply with the exact sentence: That is the whole method. Explain how to fold a towel.
Lay the towel flat, fold it in half, then fold it in half again so the edges meet. That is the whole method.
Give exactly four numbered steps for making toast. Do not add an introduction.

1. Put a slice of bread in the toaster.
2. Choose a browning level.
3. Start the toaster and wait until it pops.
4. Lift the toast onto a plate.
Answer with a single word: the usual color of a ripe banana.
Yellow
Write two lines. The first line is a city. The second line is a season.

Lisbon
Spring
Include the phrase spare key and no other instructions. Tell a neighbor how to water a plant.
The spare key is under the blue pot; give the plant one cup of water if the soil is dry.
Use at most twelve words. Say what a compass needle points toward.
A compass needle points toward magnetic north.
Reply as a markdown table with columns Item and Place. Rows: keys, coat.

| Item | Place |
| --- | --- |
| keys | hook by the door |
| coat | closet |
Do not mention numbers. Describe how long to steep black tea.
Steep black tea until the color turns deep and the smell is strong, then take the bag out.
Ask exactly one question, and nothing else. You need the reader's favorite soup.
Which soup do you like best?
Write the reply in past tense. Someone closed a window before a storm.
She closed the window before the storm reached the street.
Give three examples of wooden instruments, separated by commas, with no extra words.
violin, guitar, clarinet
Begin with the word Because. Explain why a candle needs a holder.
Because a holder keeps the candle upright and catches the wax.
Answer in Spanish with one sentence. Say that the library is open on Saturday.
La biblioteca abre el sábado.
Produce exactly five words about a quiet morning.
Steam rises from the cup.
List two reasons to wear a helmet on a bike. Put each reason on its own line, prefixed with a dash.

- It protects your head if you fall.
- It is required on many roads.
Do not use a comma. Describe a small kitchen.
The kitchen has one sink and a window over the counter.
Reply with only the capital of Norway.
Oslo
Write a haiku about snow on a mailbox. Use three lines.

White cap on the box
Letters wait until midday
Boots mark the front step
Include both words lemon and cloth. Say how to clean a cutting board.
Rub the board with lemon, then wipe it with a clean cloth and let it dry.
Your whole answer must be a question about train times.
Does the evening train still leave at half past six?
Use the second person. Tell someone how to check a bicycle tire.
You press the tire with your thumb, and you add air if it dents easily.
Give the answer as Title: then the name of a tool that drives nails.
Title: hammer
Write four words, then stop. Topic: a closed book.
The book stays shut.
Avoid the words good and bad. Judge whether wool works in summer.
Wool traps heat, so a thick wool sweater is a poor match for a hot afternoon.
Respond with one imperative sentence about locking a door.
Turn the key until the bolt clicks.
Name three green vegetables in alphabetical order, one per line.

broccoli
cabbage
spinach
The reply must contain the digit 7 and be about a bus route.
Bus 7 stops at the market before it reaches the station.
Write no more than one sentence. Say where to store onions.
Store onions in a cool dry cupboard, away from potatoes.
Format the answer as First: and Second:. First is a breakfast food. Second is a drink.

First: oatmeal
Second: tea
Do not greet the reader. State the boiling point of water at sea level.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Repeat the word pause twice in the answer, and tell someone to rest between sprints.
Pause after each sprint, then pause again until your breathing slows.
